results.description:
'Makes me feel as if I am there… Loved this!' NetGalley reviewer ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

The Mayfair Club survived the Blitz. But can it survive betrayal?

September 1944. Deirdre Rowan is a passionate Irish receptionist at the exclusive Mayfair Ladies’ Club in London. When new manager Maxwell Forster arrives, Deirdre is immediately attracted to him. But what Deirdre doesn't know is that Max has a secret: he is a German officer concealing his real name, fleeing his country’s oppressive regime.

When Deirdre is enlisted by DCI Jonathan Rudge to report anything suspicious that she notices in the club, the mysterious Max must not escape her scrutiny, even though Deirdre is in danger of falling in love with him…

Surrounded by lies and conflicting loyalties, Deirdre must try to uncover the secrets hidden around her, hoping they might answer the dreaded question: could Max be a traitor to her country – and her heart?

This moving new novel from bestselling author Molly Green explores the sacrifices made in the name of freedom and love.

About the author

MOLLY GREEN has travelled the world, unpacking her suitcase in a score of different countries which often became her new place of work. On returning to England, she set up an estate agency business which she ran and expanded for twenty-five years. Eventually, she sold her business to give herself time and space to pursue her dream to write novels. She has since moved to a village outside Lewes in East Sussex and writes her novels from a railway carriage in the garden, and hopes her new rescued cat, Betsy, will in time stroll over to keep her company.

You can keep up with Molly at mollygreenauthor.com
